answer: One identity leases one registered oyster bed: the register records bed, lease and key, and one bed backs exactly one identity. The lessee tends it one season under a plume buoy; weight counts only after 180 days and a harvest inspection. Each fake costs 1,100 units — 700 lease, 300 spat, 100 gear — and 180 days; no zephyr shortens the season. One hundred fakes cost 110,000 units, 100 beds and 18,000 days. Cheapest cheat: buy a ready lease, ~2,500 units, but the seller surrenders their own bed; rented beds fail inspection, forged leases fail the register, every voyage logged to one key.
